en.title: Buy land in Southern Chile with advisory | Land Advisors
en.description: Strategic advisory to buy the right land in Southern Chile. We don't sell land — we help you decide with less risk. Strategic meeting in Puerto Varas and online.

#inicio h1.en:
We help you buy
the right land.

#inicio .hero-lead.en: We don't sell land. We are independent consultants: we read territory and market so you choose with less risk and better negotiation — in the Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello basin.

#inicio .hero-metrics .hero-metric:nth-c.en: Anyone buying land in the south

#problema .section-title.en: You don't lack options. You lack criteria to decide.

#problema .section-intro.en: Finding land in the south is easy. Buying the right one — at a fair price and without surprises later — is the hard part. That's the risk we help you manage.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(1) ..en: «I saw dozens of listings and don't know which to compare»
Too much information, too little order: you need filters before visiting.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(2) ..en: «I fell in love with the place — but does it fit my project?»
Home, cabins or business: validate land and surroundings before offering.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(3) ..en: «I live in Santiago and don't know the local dynamics»
Distance, connectivity and how the sector is evolving change the decision a lot.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(4) ..en: We know how to tell good prices from bad ones — and help you negotiate with that knowledge.

#confianza .section-confianza__metric.en: More than 100,000 UF invested through our advisory

#consecuencias .section-intro.en: Buying without independent advisory doesn't always fail — but when it does, the cost in time and money is high.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(1) p.en: Access, subdivision rules or distance to services the listing didn't highlight.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(2) p.en: Paying for the photo without comparing real alternatives in the area.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(3) p.en: Imagining cabins or retail on land where it isn't viable.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(4) p.en: Traveling south without a map or priorities — exhausting and inconclusive.

#solucion .section-title.en: On your side before you buy

#solucion .section-intro.en: We work for the buyer, not the seller. We know visible supply and alternatives not on portals — and we tell you transparently when something doesn't fit.

#solucion .pensamos-lead.en: Less noise. Better decisions. An ally who already knows the basin.

#solucion .cards-bento .card:nth-child(1.en: We save you trips: zones, prices and warning signs before you go south.

#solucion .cards-bento .card:nth-child(2.en: We read what the listing doesn't say
Access, subdivision rules, neighbourhood and sector evolution — in plain language.

#solucion .cards-bento .card:nth-child(3.en: If it's not the right alternative, we say so and keep searching with you.

#casos .section-title.en: What changes when you look before you buy

#casos .section-intro.en: Three decisions in the Lago Llanquihue basin. Past results don't guarantee future results; they show how we work when market and territory data are available.

#casos .case:nth-child(1) h3 a.en: From rural restriction to commercial potential

#casos .case:nth-child(1) .case-dl dd:nt.en: Commercial land with a ban on commercial use.
Connectivity, traffic flow and urban expansion with commercial potential.
Purchase with restriction lifted and estimated value capture of 50% above price paid.

#casos .case:nth-child(2) h3 a.en: The opportunity was in the seller

#casos .case:nth-child(2) .case-dl dd:nt.en: One more plot on the market.
Seller urgency and gap between asking price and real value.
Purchase at 26 million and sale at 42 million in two months.

#casos .case:nth-child(3) .case-dl dd:nt.en: Developer liquidity constraints and post-urbanisation potential.
Purchase of 4 plots for 4,400 UF; current reference ~2,000 UF per plot.

#servicios .section-title.en: Start where you are — without committing to everything

#servicios .section-intro.en: Each service covers a different stage. The usual entry point is a strategic meeting (diagnostic, 1 UF).

#servicios .service-card--featured p.en: Active land search in Southern Chile and Patagonia — for Chilean and international clients. Local Land Acquisition Partner.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(2) p.en: Structure your search: zones, budget and visit route before going south.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(3) p.en: At least 4 alternatives → comparative report of the 3 best, chosen with you.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(4) p.en: Negotiation and closing with support — no pressure to sell a specific plot.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(4) .s.en: minus 5 UF if you contracted search

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(5) p.en: Is this land a good option? Deep evaluation before committing capital.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(6) p.en: Cabins, tourism or retail: viability and plan before building.

#oportunidades .section-intro.en: Simple and repeatable — for living, investment or a project on the land.

#oportunidades .step:nth-child(1) p.en: Meeting to clarify budget, timeline and what you want to do with the land.

#oportunidades .step:nth-child(2) p.en: Zones, prices, access and risk signals — with field work and market data.

#oportunidades .step:nth-child(3) p.en: Clear recommendation, negotiation if needed, and transparency if it's worth keeping search.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(1) .faq-answer.en: No. We are not a brokerage or portal. We advise the buyer to choose well — with no pressure to sell a specific plot.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(2) .faq-answer.en: A strategic meeting (diagnostic, 1 UF): we understand your objective and deliver zones and criteria before visiting land.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(3) summary.en: Does it work if I live in Santiago?

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(3) .faq-answer.en: Yes. Many clients come from outside the region. We help you arrive in the south with a map and priorities, not blind visits.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(4) summary.en: What if the land I saw isn't a good option?

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(4) .faq-answer.en: We tell you transparently and keep searching with you. Our job is a good purchase, not a fast one.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(5) .faq-answer.en: Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello basin: Puerto Varas, Frutillar, Llanquihue, Ensenada, Puerto Octay and rural contour.

#contacto-form-intro.en: Tell us where you are in the process. After submitting, choose a calendar slot or confirm via WhatsApp with José.

#contacto .contact-info p:nth-of-type(4).en: We respond to patrimonial investors, families seeking quality of life, developers and local entrepreneurs in Southern Chile.

#contacto-form .form-hint.en: The first step is usually a strategic diagnostic to structure your search.

.contact-success__title.en: Done! Choose how to book your diagnostic

.contact-success__lead.en: Your information is with Land Advisors. Pick your preferred next step:

.contact-success__note.en: Diagnostic ~30 min · Online or in Puerto Varas · We reply on business days (Mon–Fri).

#cta p.en: A ~30-minute diagnostic to understand your objective — with no obligation to buy.

#innovacion .section-title.en: Technology at the service of your decision

#innovacion .section-intro-wide.en: To compare purchase alternatives and evaluate commercial projects — cabins, strip centers, development — we integrate AI, geospatial data and verifiable regulation. We don't replace human judgement or field work: we amplify it.

#territorios .section-title.en: Where we build knowledge and strategy

#territorios .section-intro.en: We operate mainly in the Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello basin, focused on rural contour around urban centres — where the biggest changes and development opportunities often appear.

#nosotros .about-copy p:nth-of-type(1).en: Land Advisors Chile is led by José Hernán Katz C., a consultant specialised in real estate strategy, land purchase and project evaluation in Southern Chile.

#nosotros .about-copy p:nth-of-type(2).en: We combine permanent field work with technology — GIS, digital cartography, geospatial analysis and AI — to help families, investors and entrepreneurs buy with criteria and evaluate projects with backing.

#nosotros .about-copy p:nth-of-type(3).en: Our identity is closer to an explorer than a seller: walking paths, visiting land and understanding places from the inside, backed by verifiable data.

#partners .section-intro.en: We work with leading companies to help you develop your project in Southern Chile.

#innovacion .inno-card--hero p.en: We use Retrieval Augmented Generation to connect AI models with our territorial, regulatory and market knowledge. Each analysis draws on verifiable sources — planning instruments, cartography, public data and local experience — not generic answers.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(2) p.en: Geospatial layers, land use, connectivity and urban expansion integrated in one territorial reading.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(3) p.en: Google Earth and remote sensing to detect patterns the market has not yet priced in.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(4) p.en: Models that process large volumes of regulatory, demographic and real estate data with traceability.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(5) p.en: Public data, planning instruments, local market and field work in one decision flow.

#innovacion .inno-card--wide p.en: Innovation is not using AI for its own sake: it is building a system where human experience meets verifiable data analysis, for clear recommendations — purchase, investment or commercial project — aligned with your goals.
